title: It’s Official: Buccaneers linebacker Lavonte David retiring after 14 seasons

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: It’s Official: Buccaneers linebacker Lavonte David retiring after 14 seasons
sources.description: Veteran linebacker Lavonte David, who spent all 14 years of his NFL career with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, announced his retirement today. David’s historic career earned him a tie with Pro Football Hall of Famer Derrick Brooks as the career franchise leaders in total tackles (1,714), which also rank tied for the sixth-most in NFL history, […]
